Every tree in the arboretum has a story. **By sponsoring a specimen you help care
for it, study it and share it** — and you leave your mark on a living being that can
accompany several generations.

It is a beautiful way to celebrate a date, honour someone, or simply be part of a
conservation project.

## How it works

::: grid

::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center}
### 1. Choose your tree
Browse the [species catalogue](catalogue.html) or the [map](../mapa.html) and pick
the specimen you like most.
:::

::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center}
### 2. Sponsor it
Write to us and we arrange the sponsorship. You can do it in your own name, as a
**gift**, or in **honour** of someone.
:::

::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center}
### 3. Leave your mark
Your name (or that of the person honoured) appears on the **tree's profile**, and you
can visit it whenever you like.
:::

:::

## Sponsorship levels

::: grid

::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm}
### 🌱 Friend of the Arboretum

- Your name on the tree's profile
- Digital sponsorship certificate
- Arboretum news
:::

::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm style="border-top:3px solid #1E4A38;"}
### <i class="bi bi-tree"></i> Sponsor

- Everything above
- Your name also on the **physical label** beside the tree
- A guided visit for two people
:::

::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm}
### 🌲 Benefactor

- Everything above
- Featured recognition on the website
- Ideal for **companies** or institutions
:::

:::

::: {.callout-note}
Amounts and benefits are a starting point, to be tailored to each project.
:::

## A gift with roots

Looking for a different gift? Sponsoring a tree is an original and meaningful present
for birthdays, weddings, births, or to remember a loved one. We provide a
**personalized certificate** with the tree's name and location.
